name: Marc J. Kaplan
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Denver, Colorado
education: University of Denver Sturm College of Law
about: As an 20+ time Super Lawyers selectee, an AV Preeminent® Rated attorney with Martindale-Hubbell®, and an attorney with 40 years of experience protecting the rights of his clients, Marc Kaplan has earned a reputation as a skilled strategist and advocate in court. Marc primarily handles highly complex cases in the areas of Legal and Professional Malpractice, Attorney Fee Disputes, Personal Injury and Divorce, as well as appeals in all civil areas of the law. Marc's cases are often referred by other attorneys who feel they lack the expertise needed to navigate the legal system in complex or high conflict cases. Marc has appeared in over 1000 cases in Colorado, plus numerous cases in the Colorado Court of Appeals, Colorado Supreme Court, and Federal Courts and has been a frequent lecturer and legal expert on Colorado and National news print and television organizations. Marc also is often hired as an expert witness, establishing the standard of care for other attorneys and whether an attorney has fallen below that standard. Marc partners with a team of excellent lawyers and paralegals to provide the highest level of advice and representation.
